extensionDescription: Review what matters: filter GitHub pull request diffs with your own presets and see the real size of what you review.
panelNotLoaded: $1 files not loaded yet, so line counts are partial
panelAnnouncePartial: $1 of them haven't loaded yet, so line counts are partial.
optionsTagline: Review what matters. Each filter becomes a button on a pull request's changed-files page.
helpBody: A file is shown when its path matches Include and doesn't match Exclude. Both are JavaScript regular expressions, tested against the full path (for example src/components/Button.tsx) and not case-sensitive. An empty Include matches every path.
helpTests: tests and stories, as an Exclude
helpAll: All is always available and shows every file.
reposHint: Optional. Added next to the filters above, only on the matching repository.
tryHint: See which buttons would show a file, using what's on this page, saved or not.
tryEmpty: Type a file path to check it.
tryOnlyAll: Only $1 shows this file. No filter matches it.
shareHint: Send your filters to a teammate, or bring in theirs.
copyHint: Copies every filter on this page, saved or not.
copyFallbackHint: Copying isn't allowed here. Select the text and copy it yourself.
importHint: Paste what they copied. It replaces the filters on this page, and nothing changes until you save.
errorRepo: Use owner/name, or owner/* for every repository of an owner.
statusFixFilters: Some filters need fixing before you can save.
statusFixRepos: Check the repository names before saving.
statusSaved: Saved. Open pull requests pick it up right away.
statusQuota: Too many filters to sync. Remove a few and try again.
importEmpty: That text has no filters in it. Ask your teammate to copy their filters again.
importInvalid: That text isn't a copied set of filters. Paste exactly what $1 produced.
welcomeLead: Big pull requests mix the code you need to read with tests, generated files and things other people own. Focus Diff adds a bar to GitHub that shows only the files you pick, with the real count of what is left to review.
howStep1Body: Each filter becomes a button. A file shows up when its path matches the filter's Include pattern and doesn't match its Exclude pattern.
howStep2Body: On the Files changed tab, the bar shows up in the bottom-right corner, with All plus your filters.
howStep3Body: Only the matching files stay. The file tree, Files changed and the +/− totals update to match. All brings everything back.
previewLabel: Example of the bar on a pull request
recipesHint: Add the ones that fit how you review. They're regular filters, so you can rename or tweak them later in settings.
recipeAddedNotice: Added $1. Open a pull request to try it.
recipeStackDescription: Review the UI and the API in separate passes, without tests and stories in the way.
recipeAreaTitle: Focus on one part of the codebase
recipeAreaDescription: Only the folder your team owns. Swap payments for your own path, and add it to a single repository if it only exists there.
recipeTestsTitle: Read the code before the tests
recipeTestsDescription: Two buttons: one hides tests, stories and mocks, the other shows only the tests.
recipeGeneratedDescription: Hide lockfiles, snapshots, minified files and build output that nobody reads line by line.
recipeInfraDescription: CI workflows, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes and YAML config, for the reviewer who owns the platform.
recipeDatabaseDescription: Migrations, SQL and schema files, which deserve a careful look before merging.
recipeDocsDescription: Markdown, text files and anything under docs/, for writers and product reviewers.
welcomeShortcuts: Switch filters without the mouse: $1 next, $2 previous, $3 all files.
filtersEmptyWithExamples: No filters yet. Add one, or start from an example.
timeHint: Estimated review time, at about $1 changed lines per hour

imported.1: Imported 1 filter. Review it, then save.
imported.n: Imported $1 filters. Review them, then save.

guideStale: This pull request changed since the guide was written.
guideSetupBody: Connect an AI provider with your own key, and Focus Diff splits a pull request into chapters: the core of the change first, then its consequences, then the supporting details.
guideConfirmBody: Focus Diff will send this pull request's diff ($1 files, about $2 tokens) to $3.
guideErrorAuth: The provider didn't accept the API key.
guideErrorModel: The provider couldn't find this model or address.
guideErrorRate: The provider is limiting requests right now. Try again in a moment.
guideErrorServer: The provider had a problem. Try again in a moment.
guideErrorRefusal: The model declined to write this guide.
guideErrorLength: The guide didn't fit in the model's output limit. Try a model with a larger output.
guideErrorFormat: The model's answer wasn't a valid guide. Try again, or pick a more capable model.
guideErrorDiff: Couldn't download this pull request's diff from GitHub.
guideErrorDiffAuth: GitHub asked to sign in before sharing this diff. Sign in to GitHub in this browser and try again.
guideErrorEmpty: This pull request has no file changes to guide.
guideErrorPermission: Focus Diff no longer has access to the provider. Save the AI settings again.
aiHint: Bring your own key. Focus Diff talks to the provider directly, never through a server of its own.
aiBaseUrlHint: Any service that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API, like Ollama or LM Studio running on your machine.
aiKeyHint: Stored only in this browser. It's never synced or shown again.
aiModelHint: Load the list from the provider, or type a model ID.
aiPrivacy: A guide sends the pull request's title, description and diff to the provider you choose, only when you ask for one. Check the provider's data policy before using it with private code.
aiForgotten: Focus Diff will ask again before sending any repository.
aiSaved: Saved. Open a pull request and pick the guide button in the Focus Diff bar.
aiRemoved: Removed the key from this browser.
aiErrorUrl: Enter a valid http or https address.
aiErrorPermission: Focus Diff needs your permission to reach $1.
aiErrorAuth: The provider didn't accept the API key.
aiErrorNotFound: Nothing found at this address. Check it, or type the model ID yourself.
aiErrorRate: The provider is limiting requests. Try again in a moment.
